title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - OnBodyWearable
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/OnBodyWearable. A wearable device having direct contact with the physical body of its Wearer (e.g. a wristband). Subclass of WearableDevice per the SAREF4WEAR ontology; inherited properties are documented on the WearableDevice model and not repeated here. Its own defining axiom is the isLocatedOn relationship (a sub-property of WearableDevice.isLocated) to a Wearer. Parent of TextileBasedWearable.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'OnBodyWearable'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

isLocatedOn.description: Relationship. The Wearer on whose body this wearable is located, i.e. the distance between the wearable and the wearer is zero or close to zero (s4wear:isLocatedOn, sub-property of isLocated). Links to a Wearer entity.
